code_set.name: Form 4 transaction codes
code_set.definition: The code an insider writes for the character of each transaction reported on Form 4 (Table I column 3, Table II column 4) and Form 5
code_set.authority: SEC Form 4 General Instruction 8, Transaction Codes (https://www.sec.gov/files/form4.pdf, sha256 275cfc9188bc1c7b7a5b8c45abb03c799b64f9e1fe74c92a28e97598778abc2d, read 2026-10-13)

hints.text: One letter for the kind of transaction: P a purchase, S a sale, A an award, M an exercise of an exempt derivative, F shares withheld for tax, G a gift, J other (described in a footnote)
Telling trades (P, S) from awards, exercises and gifts in insider transactions
Reading K alone: the SEC asks for K beside the code that describes the transaction (S/K, P/K)
